Trucks collide in intersection – Main Street & Highway 20

By
Journal
-
July 30, 2026
0
450
Facebook
Twitter
Pinterest
WhatsApp
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 0:45
    Instaread

    Piedmont firefighters work at the scene after two trucks collided at the intersection of Main Street and Highway 20 Tuesday afternoon. One truck rear ended the other spilling some of its load. A state trooper investigated and there were no injuries.
